reason: The README clearly describes a plugin for scheduling messages and automatically executing them later in the current conversation; human review is appropriate because it advertises default full-access permissions and autonomous execution.

summaries.zh: 用于为当前对话中的消息设置执行时间，并在到点后自动继续执行计划任务。
summaries.en: Schedules messages in the current conversation and automatically continues executing them at the specified time.

capabilities: Schedules user-provided messages for future execution
Automatically continues execution in the current conversation at the scheduled time
Supports multiple concurrent or sequential scheduled tasks
Deletes all scheduled tasks through a clear-all action
Uses default full-access permissions according to the README
